events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
This is Maria Alvarez, born 03/04/1968. I need my lisinopril refilled.
Thank you. Is your date of birth March fourth, nineteen sixty eight, or April third, nineteen sixty eight?
It's 03/04/1968. I'm sure. Just send the refill, please.
I need the date in words before I can look up any medicine. Is that March fourth or April third, nineteen sixty eight?
